title: Norml SEO Technical Analysis
pitch: Audit eight technical SEO areas and produce a prioritized report with explicit evidence and coverage.
problem: A score or sampled crawl can hide unavailable checks and unverified site-wide assumptions.
The audit records exact coverage, measured findings and blocked sources in six report sections.

flow.d: Confirm host, CMS, locales and crawl boundary.
Use authorized crawler/provider and public evidence.
Rank by severity, reach and dependencies.
Save all six sections with gaps and evidence.

items.name: Eight areas
items.desc: Indexation, speed, metadata, schema, mobile, linking, international and serving.

items.name: Six report sections
items.desc: Summary, crawl, speed, meta, schema and unified findings.

items.name: Evidence discipline
items.desc: Separate lab/field, URL/origin and live/indexed observations.

items.name: Limited tooling
items.desc: Representative public checks with explicitly partial coverage.

items.role: Six report sections and evidence columns.

items: Read-only; no website/provider mutation or deployments.
No invented health score, hours, cost or named assignees.
A sample cannot establish complete crawl/inlink/orphan coverage.
Provider failures remain blocked checks, not guessed data.
